title: Church of God in Christ and singing blues and religious songs
summary: Raised in the sanctified church; he sings religious songs and blues and says the church does not object. Briefly mentions his wife and ten children.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
